summary: Frontend-only testing of the desktop layout and PWA changes. Desktop (1366x800): the staff column is centred at x=123 and 1120px wide on navy, with no horizontal overflow. The 6 overview stat cards sit in one row (171px each). Registrations cards are in 2 columns. Attendance, Faculty, Day Summary, Not Arrived, Settings and Scanner render cleanly. The scanner camera box is centred, 600x320. Phone (390x844): landing, register, my-pass, staff login, dashboard (2 stats per row), single-column registrations and scanner all have scrollWidth 390, so nothing overflows. Install button: hidden with the desktop Chrome UA. With an iPhone UA it shows (266x44); the first tap shows install-ios-help with the correct text and a second tap hides it. PWA assets: manifest.json, icon-192 (192x192), icon-512, icon-maskable-512 and apple-touch-icon (180x180) all return 200 with image/png. The manifest has name, short_name, display=standalone and any+maskable icons. FAILED: the served page head has NO <link rel=manifest>, NO apple-touch-icon and NO apple-mobile-web-app-* meta tags. The cause is that app.json web.output='single' ignores app/+html.tsx. Only theme-color is present, and it comes from app.json web.themeColor.

integration_issues.issue: GET / (and every route) serves the default @expo/cli template index.html. app/+html.tsx is only used for static output ('static'/'server'), but app.json has web.output='single'. As a result, <link rel='manifest'>, <link rel='apple-touch-icon'>, <link rel='icon' 192>, apple-mobile-web-app-capable/title/status-bar and mobile-web-app-capable are all missing. This was checked both with curl and at runtime (document.querySelector('link[rel=manifest]') is null). Effects: Chrome/Android will never fire beforeinstallprompt because there is no manifest link, so the install button never appears on Android or desktop. On iOS, Add to Home Screen falls back to a screenshot icon with the default title.

issues: The Dashboard and Sign out Pressables (scanner-dashboard-btn, scanner-logout-btn) have no minHeight/minWidth. Their tap targets are about 18px tall, below 44px. This predates this change.
The tab bar row shifts vertically by about 3–9px between Overview, Registrations and Settings (horizontal ScrollView height changes). This is cosmetic.

action_items: HIGH: Make the PWA head tags actually get served. app.json uses web.output='single', so app/+html.tsx is ignored. Create /app/frontend/public/index.html: copy node_modules/@expo/cli/static/template/index.html and add <link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.json">, <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">, <link rel="icon" sizes="192x192" href="/icon-192.png"> and the apple-mobile-web-app-* / mobile-web-app-capable metas. Do NOT change app.json. Restart expo, then verify with curl / | grep manifest.
Low: add minHeight 44 to the scanner header Dashboard and Sign out Pressables.
critical_code_review_comments: +html.tsx has no effect in single-output mode, so it is dead code unless the output mode changes.

install-app.tsx: the logic is correct, but on Android/desktop it depends on beforeinstallprompt, which needs the manifest link (currently missing). Also, iPadOS 13+ Safari reports a Mac UA, so the iPad regex won't match. This is minor.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all layout checks passed; the PWA head-tag check failed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: qa-admin@olam.delta / QaAdmin#2026x with role login-role-super_admin. The wide-layout breakpoint is width >= 900. To test the iPhone UA, use browser.new_context(user_agent=...). After the fix, check curl $URL/ | grep manifest.
rca_of_issue: Expo Router only renders app/+html.tsx for static/server output. With web.output='single', Metro serves public/index.html if it exists, otherwise the built-in template. There is no public/index.html, so the custom head tags never reach the browser.
